manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Gravity slows the ball on the way up and speeds it up on the way down. At the top, the ball is still for an instant while gravity still pulls it down.
manifest.description: An interactive scene showing a ball tossed vertically. A blue motion vector changes size and direction, while a dashed gravity vector remains constant pointing downward.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows. Press Play again to watch the ball fall, or drag the timeline to inspect any moment.
